description: §15.10.1 (S458 third round, N3) — an escape inside a string literal in a component body's quoted attribute round-trips through expansion exactly as the same attribute written outside a component: `title="${n + 'it\'s'}"` renders `ait's` (it used to be cooked to `'it's'` before the expander re-parsed the body — then truncated to `'it'`, or E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC), and `data-pat="^\d+$"` keeps one backslash (it used to double).
rationale: §15.10.1 substitutes the caller value for identifier references only; everything else in the attribute is the author's text and is preserved — the component's `<span>` and the plain `<span>` render identically.
